title: Give APRA the documents to register as a registered financial corporation
what: A registrable corporation that is not yet registered must give APRA the documents the Act requires (s 9).

sources.title: Financial Sector (Collection of Data) Act 2001
sources.quote: 9 Obligations of corporations (1) If, on the commencement of this Part, a registrable corporation is not a registered entity, the corporation must, before the end of 60 days after the date of commencement of this Part, give to APRA the documents mentioned in subsection (5).

reach.condition: if it is a corporation that must register under s 9
